text:
maria_sec: Hi team, auditor asked for proof of recent RBAC change + KMS key usage for the inference-service. They want a small sample (10 users) showing change approval, deploy, and KMS decrypt events. Can we bundle that by EOD?

auditor_jane: quick clarifying Q — acceptable timeframe is the last 30 days, and we only need production, not staging, right? Also prefer raw log snippets + verification steps.

maria_sec: yes last 30 days, prod only. Raw snippets + a short mapping doc that ties each snippet to control IDs (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9-ish).

tom_infra: I can export role-binding diffs from k8s audit logs and the IAM change ticket metadata. Will need a list of the 10 sample subjects.

sam_sre: For KMS decrypts we can pull CloudKMS logs and correlate by request_id. Suggest we use this query in Splunk/ELK: 
```
index=prod_kms action=Decrypt earliest=-30d@d
| stats count by user, key_name, request_id, _time
| sort -_time
| head 200
```
That gives request ids to match with token-use traces.

olivia_prod: I'll pick 10 users across teams (api, frontend, infra) and share emails. Also note two of them were part of the RBAC change rollout on 2025-11-14.

maria_sec: good. Tom — can you include the approval thread (JIRA ticket + approver signatures) and the canary deploy artifact? Auditor likes PR/CHG links.

tom_infra: yes. I'll attach: CHG-1389 diff, PR 4521, and the deploy manifest hash. Also will include k8s audit snippet: 
```
{"kind":"RoleBinding","verb":"update","user":"olivia_prod","resource":"rolebindings","timestamp":"2025-11-14T15:23:01Z"}
```

auditor_jane: for the KMS piece — can you show key metadata (rotation schedule + who has wrap/unwrap perms)? A screenshot of KeyRing ACL + exported policy is fine.

maria_sec: we'll pull key metadata from KMS console and an `gcloud` policy export. Example command we'll include: 
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy inference-key --location=global --keyring=inference-ring
```

sam_sre: also flagging one vuln triage note — the RBAC change removed broad cluster-admin bind which was used by a sidecar. We mitigated with a scoped policy and a follow-up CR. Will include vuln ticket and mitigation timeline.

olivia_prod: FYI that mitigation caused a <5min error spike during canary on 11/14. I captured traces and the incident link: INC-2025-349.

security-bot: Automated note: evidence export bundle created (bundle-id: bndl-20251115-7). Location: s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-7.zip

maria_sec: thanks bot. Tom/sam/olivia — next steps: 1) tom attach RBAC diffs + approval artifacts, 2) sam attach Splunk KMS snippets and query used, 3) olivia provide user sample and incident link. I'll assemble mapping doc that ties each snippet to SOC2 control IDs and add MD5 manifest.

tom_infra: added CHG-1389 and PR link to CHG ticket. Also included a short README with file list.

sam_sre: pasted first 3 KMS log snippets below (sanitized): 
```
user: olivia@redwood.com key: projects/p1/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/inference-key action: Decrypt request_id: req-9a7c time: 2025-11-14T15:23:05Z
user: alice@redwood.com key: projects/p1/... action: Decrypt request_id: req-9b8d time: 2025-11-20T04:12:11Z
user: bob@redwood.com key: projects/p1/... action: Decrypt request_id: req-1c2f time: 2025-11-22T10:02:33Z
```

auditor_jane: perfect — can you also include the proof link that those request_ids tie to actual inference calls (eg request log request_id header)? We need the chain: approval -> role change -> deploy -> KMS decrypt -> API call.

maria_sec: will map request_ids to API logs. We have header `x-rw-request-id` in prod logs. Sam, can you correlate by request_id to the api logs and include 2 examples in the bundle?

sam_sre: on it. Correlation query: 
```
index=prod_http x-rw-request-id=REQID
| table _time, user_agent, path, request_id, response_status
```
I'll include two full traces (sanitized).

olivia_prod: shared sample list in the ticket: [olivia, alice, bob, carol, dave, erin, frank, grace, harry, isabel] — emails attached.

maria_sec: timeline estimate: artifacts ready in ~3hrs. Auditor — any non-negotiable extra format? PDF vs raw JSON?

auditor_jane: raw JSON + short mapping doc (PDF or MD) is ideal. Also include MD5 checksums for each file. Thanks.

maria_sec: ok will include checksums and manifest. I'll post final bundle link here when ready. :thumbsup:

security-bot: Alert: bundle bndl-20251115-7 passed integrity check (md5 manifest verified).

maria_sec: bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/exports/bndl-20251115-7.zip — sharing with auditor now. Closing thread after confirmation.

auditor_jane: received, thanks. I'll review and ping if follow-ups.

maria_sec: thanks everyone!"
